item.title: Abandoned recycling boxes, 22nd November
item.description:
There are multiple broken and abandoned recycling boxes and food caddies on Normal Terrace, approximately opposite numbers 7/8. These have been building up for a few years up and down the street and I have collected them together there over time to try and keep them out the way. Would it be possible for someone to come and collect them? We use all of the full size bins with the red, yellow and blue tops, it's just the smaller ones that aren't in use. If the pieces of fence that have also been dumped there at some point could also be removed that would be great.

item.title: No lights no zebra crossing, 20th November
item.description:
Dear Gloucestershire County Council Highways Team, I am writing to raise serious concerns regarding pedestrian safety on Tommy Taylors Lane, particularly near the junction with Prince Regent Avenue and the entrance to the Midwinter Estate in Cheltenham. Children regularly use this route to travel to and from Pittville School. Despite the regular presence of schoolchildren and other pedestrians, there is no clearly designated pedestrian crossing facility at this location. I consider this a significant road-safety concern. Children should not have to negotiate crossing a road without appropriate infrastructure to alert drivers and provide a safe crossing opportunity. I understand that this location has previously been the subject of community petitions requesting a pedestrian crossing, including a petition received by the County Council on 7 August 2024. I therefore request: 1. A formal pedestrian and highway safety assessment at this location. 2. A review of the previous petitions and any assessments or decisions made in response. 3. Consideration of installing a zebra crossing with appropriate lighting or a signal-controlled pedestrian crossing. 4. If a permanent crossing cannot immediately be provided, consideration of interim safety measures, including warning signs, road markings and traffic-calming measures. 5. An assessment under the Council's School Safety Zone and Safer Routes to School policies. 6. Confirmation of the traffic volume, vehicle speeds and pedestrian collision data considered when assessing this location. I would also appreciate confirmation of whether the Council has consulted Pittville School regarding the number of pupils using this route. The absence of a recorded serious accident should not prevent preventative action being considered. The purpose of road-safety measures is to reduce foreseeable risks before a child is seriously injured. I look forward to receiving a formal response explaining what action the Council intends to take.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tommy Taylors Lane, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
